title: Grip is okay, tad slippery
text: Grip is okay, tad slippery. 2inch in length.  Plastic covering over metal clips.  Firm hold, best for chip bags, but tad slippery.  I wouldn’t use these for my flour bags.  I might use these for paperwork.  They are light and not difficult to open.

product_metadata.title: Farberware Classic Multipurpose Bag Clips, set of 12, Assorted
features: This set of 12 bag clips seals in freshness of foods by keeping bags tightly closed
Suitable for use in the pantry or freezer
Perfect for organizing letters, papers and office supplies
description: This Farberware Set of 12 Multi-Purpose Clips comes in assorted colors so you can use different colors for different needs. Use them in the pantry or freezer to keep open foods closed. Or use them to organize and clip letters, coupons, recipes, and more. Set of 12. Hand-wash with warm water and a mild detergent; rinse and dry immediately.
